name: olv2sub
description: Open LLM Leaderboard v2 at sub-task level: raw lm-eval-harness scores for the 42 leaf metrics behind the six v2 aggregates, one row per leaderboard model.
row_order: model fullname (HF repo id), Python sorted() / Unicode code-point order
column_order: groups in leaderboard order IFEval, BBH, MATH_Lvl5, GPQA, MUSR, MMLU-PRO; sub-tasks alphabetical within group; IFEval metrics in the order prompt_level_strict_acc, inst_level_strict_acc, prompt_level_loose_acc, inst_level_loose_acc

score_definition.scale: raw metric in [0,1] from lm-eval-harness results JSON (NOT the leaderboard's baseline-normalised 0-100 score)
score_definition.ifeval/*: leaderboard_ifeval <metric>,none; prompt-level metrics average over 541 prompts, inst-level over the instructions they contain
score_definition.math_hard/*: leaderboard_math_<task>_hard exact_match,none (4-shot, generative); value from the selected file, i.e. after the leaderboard's MATH re-scoring when the selected file is a 2024-10-24 / 2025-02-13 re-upload. Scorer versions are MIXED exactly as on the leaderboard: v3.0 = 2025-02-13 bulk re-scoring (consistent with HF's Feb-2025 Math-Verify fix), v2.0 = 2024-10-24 fix or runs after 2025-02-13 that were not re-scored, v1.0 = original 2024 scorer; see models.math_hard_task_version, counts.math_hard_task_version_counts and counts.math_hard_aggregate_shift_between_scorer_versions. Temporal splits at >= 2025-02-13 put v2.0 models on the test side
score_definition.harness_group_aggregate: sample-weighted mean of sub-tasks (lm-eval weight_by_size); IFEval group value = prompt_level_strict_acc (as in data/open_llm.csv)
score_definition.missing: NaN in CSV, B=0 and O=0 in npz
score_definition.models.params_b: contents '#Params (B)'; the sentinel -1 is mapped to null (models.model_num_parameters from the result JSON is exact)

selection_rules.row_per_contents_entry: best result file = min L_inf between the six leaderboard-raw aggregates recomputed from the file's sub-tasks and the contents row; ties (<= 1e-12) -> latest file timestamp, then path
selection_rules.tie_sensitivity: where several eligible files tie, their leaf values can still differ (MATH-hard sub-tasks re-scored with identical totals, IFEval loose metrics); those rows depend on the tie-break, not only on the contents table: models.match_tied_leaf_differs / match_tied_max_abs_leaf_diff, counts.ties_* (ties_differing_cells_by_group counts (model, column) pairs where any tied file differs from the kept one)
selection_rules.eligible_files: same model_name; all six aggregates computable; no sample limit
selection_rules.row_per_model: models listed under two precisions keep the contents row with the later Submission Date, then bfloat16, then eval_name; the other row's eval_name is recorded
selection_rules.dropped: contents rows with Flagged=True; result-only models absent from contents

cost.per_benchmark: benchmarks.n_samples = effective n-samples of the harness task (items evaluated per model). The four ifeval/* columns share one run (cost_group) of 541 prompts. Generative tasks (IFEval, MATH) cost more per item than log-likelihood multiple-choice tasks.
cost.shared_items: benchmarks.item_group: columns with the same value draw on one question pool. The three gpqa/* columns are separate harness runs (separate cost_group, so their costs add as run on the leaderboard) over NESTED subsets of the same questions: gpqa/diamond within gpqa/main within gpqa/extended (n = 198, 448, 546; Rein et al. 2023, arXiv:2311.12022), so they are correlated by construction and a model scored on gpqa/extended has already been asked every diamond/main question (in a separate run, so per-item results need not coincide). The four ifeval/* columns are four metrics of one run over the same 541 prompts.
cost.totals_note: item_evaluations_per_model = sum of n_samples over distinct cost_group (IFEval counted once, GPQA 198+448+546); distinct_items_per_model = sum over item_group of the largest subset (IFEval 541 once, GPQA 546)
cost.per_model: models.total_evaluation_time_seconds = wall-clock time of the selected file's whole leaderboard run (all tasks); bulk re-uploads carry the original run's time

vs_open_llm_csv.note: Cause of each disagreement between data/open_llm.csv (written by download_open_llm.py, emulated above bit for bit) and olv2sub's harness aggregates, assigned in this order. old_value_from_subtask_fallback: the file kept by the old script has blank BBH/GPQA/MUSR group entries and its substring fallback stored the FIRST sub-task's value instead (wrong values in open_llm.csv). old_file_partial_reupload: the old script kept a partial BBH+MATH re-upload as the last file; the values it read are that file's group entries (MATH equals the leaderboard's), the other aggregates are NaN (incomplete rows, not misreads). different_complete_file_selected: the old script kept another complete file (last in path order), read correctly; olv2sub keeps the file matching the leaderboard contents table. source_group_value_ne_own_subtasks: same file, read correctly, but the file's own group value differs from the sample-weighted mean of its sub-tasks (open_llm.csv holds the group value, which is also what the leaderboard shows).
